Metadata.title: Think Bee
Metadata.description: Farm and hive guidance that stays useful on weak connections.

Theme.title: Appearance
Theme.description: Choose a colour theme for this device.
Theme.temporary: This preference could not be saved. It will last until you leave this page.

Home.summary: Your place for farm guidance, records and conversations.
Home.scanTitle: Check a hive or a crop
Home.scanBody: Take a clear photo. Think Bee will show likely causes and safe next steps.
Home.todayEmptyBody: Your inspections, planting and other reminders will appear here.
Home.recentEmptyBody: Saved scans and field notes will come together here.
Home.communityEmptyBody: Your farmer conversations and groups will appear here.

Feature.chatsBody: Direct chats, groups and communities will appear here.
Feature.recordsBody: Saved scans, field notes and upcoming work will stay available offline.
Feature.meBody: Your profile and farms belong here. Choose how Think Bee looks on this device.
Feature.adminBody: Reports, spaces and account actions will be managed here.

Scan.title: What are you checking?
Scan.body: Choose one so the photo guidance matches what you need.
Scan.hiveHint: Frames, brood, comb or the outside of a hive
Scan.cropHint: Leaves, stems, fruit or visible pest damage
Scan.notice: A scan gives likely causes, not a confirmed diagnosis.
Scan.availableLater: Photo checks will be available here. You can return to Home to explore Think Bee.

Onboarding.title: Clear guidance for farms and hives
Onboarding.body: Scan a crop or hive, keep records, and learn from other farmers.

Shell.offline: You are offline. Some actions need a connection.
Shell.errorBody: Try again. You can also use the navigation to open another page.
Shell.offlineError: Reconnect to load this page, then try again.

Pwa.offlineBody: Think Bee can still open saved pages and local records. Reconnect for scans, sign-in and new advice.
Pwa.installBody: Open Think Bee from your home screen and reach saved information more quickly on weak connections.
Pwa.installDismissed: Installation was not started. You can try again here later.
Pwa.installFailed: Installation could not start. Reload to try again, or use your browser's install option.
Pwa.update: A newer version of Think Bee is ready.

scan.title: A little help, right where you farm.
scan.body: A photo of your crops or hives. Practical guidance on what might be happening. You decide what comes next.

records.title: Your work deserves a record.
records.body: The first new leaf. A hive check. A lesson for next season. Keep the little things that make a difference.
records.alt: Rows of crops in a green field

community.title: Good things grow together.
community.body: Share what you notice. Ask another farmer. There is always something to learn from the people growing alongside you.
community.alt: Honeybees gathered on a hive frame

Welcome.footer: For farmers. For beekeepers. For the everyday.

Setup.signInBody: Your farm, your notes, your people. Sign in to pick up where you left off.
Setup.adultRequired: Confirm that you are 18 or older to create an account.
Setup.privacyShort: Your sign-in email is private. It is never shown to other farmers.
Setup.connectionRequired: Connect to the internet to sign in.
Setup.sentTo: Look for a verification link at
Setup.sameDevice: Open the one-time link in this browser to verify your email and finish setting up. After that, sign in with your email and password.
Setup.spamHint: Check your spam folder, too. If you already have an account, sign in with your password.
Setup.profileBody: Choose the name and short introduction other farmers will see.
Setup.nameInvalid: Enter a name using 1 to 80 characters.
Setup.photoLater: You can add a profile photo when photo uploads are available.
Setup.profilePrivacy: Your email and exact farm location are never shown. Crops, hive details and general area stay hidden until you choose to share them.
Setup.internalId: This identifies you in Think Bee. It is not a government ID.
Setup.farmBody: Add your first farm or apiary. You can skip this and add it later from Me.
Setup.farmNameInvalid: Enter a farm name using 1 to 120 characters.
Setup.stateRequired: Add a state when you enter an LGA.
Setup.hiveCountInvalid: Enter a whole number from 0 to {max}.
Setup.cropHint: Separate crops with commas, for example cassava, maize. Each crop starts as one crop block.
Setup.unitLimit: Use crop names under 81 characters and at most {max} hives and crop blocks together.
Setup.farmPrivacy: Farm names and locations are only visible to you. They are not added to your public profile.
Setup.unitsHint: We will create one entry for each hive and crop so you can keep their records separately.
Setup.locationHint: No GPS permission is needed here. You can give a precise location later when a feature needs it.
Setup.noFarms: No farms added yet. You can add one whenever you are ready.
Setup.syncing: Saved on this device. We are syncing your details to your account.
Setup.queued: Saved on this device. Your details will sync when you have a connection.
Setup.synced: Your submitted details are synced to your account.
Setup.accountPrompt: Sign in to set up your profile and keep your farms with you.
Setup.signOutWarning: Signing out removes unsynced setup drafts from this device.

errors.session: Your session needs checking. Sign in again; drafts stay on this device until you sign out.
errors.unavailable: We could not reach the service. Your saved drafts are safe on this device. Try again when you have a connection.
errors.invalid: Some details could not be accepted. Check your entries and try again.
errors.limited: The request limit has been reached. Wait a little, then try again.
errors.storage: We could not save on this device. Free some browser storage or allow site storage, then try again. Your entries are still on this page.
errors.expired: This link has expired or was already used. Sign in, or request a fresh verification or password reset link.
errors.configuration: Sign-in is not available on this version of the app yet. Please try again later.
errors.suspended: This account is suspended. Sign out to use another account.
errors.deleted: This account has been deleted. Sign out to continue.

Setup.storyTitle: A little care. A world of difference.
Setup.storyPhotoAlt: Green rows of crops stretching across a field
Setup.storyCaption: From the first leaf to the next harvest.
Setup.registerBody: A place for you and the things you grow.
Setup.passwordInvalid: Use a password with 8 to 128 characters.
Setup.forgotBody: Enter your email and we’ll send a link to reset your password.
Setup.resetSentBody: If there’s an account for this email, a reset link is on its way. Open it in this browser on this device.
Setup.resetBody: Make it something only you know.
Setup.resetSuccessBody: You can now sign in with your email and new password.
Setup.verificationNeeded: Verify your email first. You can request another verification link below.
Setup.credentialsInvalid: The email or password is incorrect. Check both and try again.
Setup.passwordWeak: Choose a stronger password. Avoid common or previously exposed passwords.
Setup.authLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
Setup.authUnavailable: We could not reach the sign-in service. Please try again.
Setup.registrationFailed: We could not create your account. Check your details or try signing in if you already have an account.

account.title: A private sign-in
account.body: Supabase manages your email sign-in and session. Your email is used for authentication and is never shown to other farmers.

profile.title: You choose what others see
profile.body: Your display name and bio form your chat profile. Your general area, crops and hive details stay hidden unless you choose to share them.

farms.title: Private farm details
farms.body: Your farm names and locations belong to your account. We do not ask for GPS during setup. Exact coordinates are never shown to other users.

device.title: Drafts on this device
device.body: Profile and farm drafts are saved in this browser before syncing. Signing out clears those local drafts. Use your own browser profile on a shared device.

chat.title: Conversations and advice
chat.body: Messages are not end-to-end encrypted in this version. The review team can review reported messages. Advice from farmers and AI does not replace an expert assessment.

control.title: Your choices
control.body: You can correct your profile and farm details and request account deletion. Nothing is recorded as done until you confirm it. The full privacy and retention notice will be reviewed before the public pilot.
